params.name: active
params.label: Active
params.description: Triggers the envelope. When enabled the envelope is triggered and enters the 'attack' phase; when disabled the envelope enters the 'release' phase

params.name: base
params.label: Base
params.description: Center value onto which the waveform is applied. The three separate XYZ sliders correspond to the three separate XYZ waveforms.

params.name: amount
params.label: Amount
params.description: Intensity of the ADSR curve. Higher values will have the attack and sustain values deviate further from the base. The three separate XYZ sliders correspond to the three separate XYZ outputs.

params.name: attack
params.label: Attack
params.description: Time it takes to reach the curve’s peak.

params.name: decay
params.label: Decay
params.description: Time it takes to reach the sustain stage.

params.name: sustain
params.label: Sustain
params.description: Value to be held after the attack phase while the trigger is still active.

params.name: release
params.label: Release
params.description: Time it takes for the value to return back to the base when releasing the trigger.

params.name: slopes
params.label: Slope
params.description: Envelope’s attack (X), release (Y), and decay (Z) slope. This can be used to create a more organic curve.

params.name: locked
params.label: Lock
params.description: Makes the camera immutable in the viewport

params.name: position
params.label: Position
params.description: Position of the camera

params.name: yaw
params.label: Yaw Angle
params.description: Yaw angle, in degrees.

params.name: pitch
params.label: Pitch Angle
params.description: Pitch angle, in degrees.

params.name: roll
params.label: Roll Angle
params.description: Roll angle, in degrees.

params.name: field_of_view
params.label: Field Of View
params.description: Field of View in degrees.

params.name: position
params.label: Focus Position
params.description: Position of focus for the camera.

params.name: roll
params.label: Roll Angle
params.description: Roll angle, in degrees.

params.name: saturation_adjust

params.name: value_adjust
params.label: Value adjust

params.name: vibrance_adjust
params.label: Vibrance adjust
params.description: Vibrance bias applied to the colors.

params.name: temperature_adjust
params.label: Temperature adjust
params.description: White-balance shift along the yellow/blue axis (OKlab b-axis, preserves luminance). Negative cools toward blue, positive warms toward yellow/orange.

params.name: tint_adjust
params.label: Tint adjust
params.description: White-balance shift along the green/magenta axis (OKlab a-axis, preserves luminance). Negative shifts toward green, positive toward magenta.

params.name: shadows_color
params.label: Shadows color
params.description: Tinting of the darkest colors.

params.name: midtones_color
params.label: Midtones color
params.description: Tinting of the average colors.

params.name: highlights_color
params.label: Highlights color
params.description: Tinting of the brightest colors.

params.name: chroma_color
params.label: Chroma color
params.description: Target color whose chroma is mixed into the image (OKlab chroma replacement, preserves luminance).

params.name: chroma_strength
params.label: Chroma strength
params.description: How much of the target chroma to apply. 0% leaves the image unchanged; 100% replaces chroma fully (monochromatic in the target hue, original luminance).

params.name: frequency.time_unit
params.label: Frequency time unit
params.description: The time unit the frequency should use; this can be either a free standing frequency by using Hz or Seconds, or the function of the current project's settings by using Frames or Loop Divisions

params.name: frequency.hz
params.label: Frequency
params.description: The number of times per second the waveform pattern is repeated in a second. Higher values will make the values change faster. The three separate XYZ sliders correspond to the three separate XYZ waveforms.

params.name: frequency.seconds
params.label: Frequency
params.description: The number of seconds it takes the waveform pattern to complete a full cycle. Higher values will make the values change faster. The three separate XYZ sliders correspond to the three separate XYZ waveforms.

params.name: frequency.frames
params.label: Frequency
params.description: The number of frames it takes the waveform pattern to complete a full cycle. Higher values will make the values change faster. The three separate XYZ sliders correspond to the three separate XYZ waveforms.

params.name: frequency.loop_divisions
params.label: Frequency
params.description: The number of times the waveform pattern will complete a full cycle within the time of the project's loop region. For example: a value of 1 will complete 1 cycle per loop, a value of 2 will complete 2 cycles per loop. The three separate XYZ sliders correspond to the three separate XYZ waveforms.

params.name: modes.0
params.label: Mode 1
params.description: Cycle type for the first parameter output. This is the only output used by a connected single-component parameter. For connected vector parameters, this output is used for the first component. For example, it will be used as X for a XYZ position parameter and as R for a RGB color parameter. “None” will output a constant value, “Normal” will output a cycling value, and “Inverted” will cycle in the opposite direction.

params.name: modes.1
params.label: Mode 2
params.description: Cycle type for the second parameter output. For connected vector parameters, this output is used for the second component. For example, it will be used as Y for a XYZ position parameter and as G for a RGB color parameter. “None” will output a constant value, “Normal” will output a cycling value, and “Inverted” will cycle in the opposite direction.

params.name: modes.2
params.label: Mode 3
params.description: Cycle type for the third parameter output. For connected vector parameters, this output is used for the third component. For example, it will be used as Z for a XYZ position parameter and as B for a RGB color parameter. “None” will output a constant value, “Normal” will output a cycling value, and “Inverted” will cycle in the opposite direction.

params.name: phase
params.label: Phase
params.description: Temporal offset of the waveform. The three separate XYZ sliders correspond to the three separate XYZ waveforms.

params.name: ease_function
params.label: Function
params.description: Which easing function will be applied to the input

params.name: ease_mode
params.label: Mode
params.description: Which mode of the easing function should be used

params.name: value
params.label: Value
params.description: Base signal value used as input. Any additional input signals connected via the input pin will be added to this signal.

params.name: position
params.label: Position
params.description: Center of the generated pattern.

params.name: rotation
params.label: Rotation
params.description: Orientation of the generated pattern. (Only available when not tiling)

params.name: scale
params.label: Scale
params.description: Scale of the generated pattern.

params.name: anisotropy
params.label: Anisotropy
params.description: Defines how stretched the generated pattern is. A value of 0% (default) will not stretch the pattern. Positive values will squeeze the pattern horizontally, negative values will squeeze the pattern vertically. (Only available when not tiling)

params.name: shape_type_UI
params.label: Shape type
params.description:
Represents the 3D profile of the shape used for splatting.

Single pixel will allow for interesting effects as it creates specific points on screen which can be used by the Distance node to create custom animatable voronoi patterns.

This parameter gets overwritten when connecting an input pattern.

params.name: inner_width
params.label: Inner filling
params.description: Higher values will fill the inside of the shape, hardening the edges.

params.name: rounding
params.label: Rounding
params.description: Rounding of the shapes.

params.name: secondary_size
params.label: Secondary size
params.description: Secondary size of the shape. Higher values reduce pinching on the star shape.

params.name: sides
params.label: Sides
params.description: Number of sides on the shape.

params.name: atlas_size
params.label: Atlas size
params.description: Amount of elements in the input atlas.

params.name: atlas_modulation_active
params.label: Atlas modulation
params.description: Exposes the Atlas mod pin on the Fractal node. This will allow for an external texture to drive which element in the atlas is shown.

params.name: atlas_modulation
params.label: Atlas modulation intensity
params.description: Blends between randomizing all atlas elements (0%) and fully driving the atlas element selection by the external texture (100%).

params.name: noise3D
params.label: Add Z axis
params.description: Makes the fractal animatable on the Z axis to have the patterns evolve and move without changing its properties.

params.name: seed
params.label: Seed
params.description: Seed value used to randomize position, rotation, and anything dependant on random numbers. Different seeds give different results.

params.name: z_position
params.label: Z position
params.description: Position on the Z axis changing this value makes the patterns evolve and move without changing its properties. 0% and 100% result in the same pattern which is useful to create looping animations.

params.name: z_position_modulation_active
params.label: Z position modulation
params.description: Activate the scale modulation from an external texture.

params.name: z_position_modulation
params.label: Z position modulation intensity
params.description: Scale the elements according the value of the mask plugged in the Scale modulation pin.

params.name: z_layers
params.label: Z Layers
params.description:
Amount of slices on the Z axis.

The way the pattern changes when changing the Z position is by interpolating between different Z layers, thus higher values will give more variations between 0% and 100%, lower values will allow for slower movement within a shorter time span.

params.name: iterations
params.label: Octave count
params.description:
Number of layers of splatting.

More octaves give more detailed noise patterns.

params.name: iterations_progression
params.label: Lacunarity
params.description: Defining the change in grid size of the next octave.

params.name: in_layer_blending_type
params.label: Splat blending
params.description: Blending mode inside a given octave.

params.name: octave_blending_type
params.label: Octave blending
params.description: Blending mode between octaves.

params.name: roughness
params.label: Gain
params.description: Defining the change in amplitude of the next octave. Higher values will usually result in smaller details getting more defined.

params.name: max_smoothness
params.label: Max smoothness
params.description: Smoothness of the maximum operation, higher values enforces a smoother blending.

params.name: roughness_modulation_active
params.label: Roughness modulation
params.description: Activate the roughness modulation from an external texture.

params.name: roughness_modulation
params.label: Roughness modulation intensity
params.description: Scale the intensity of the roughness according the value of the mask plugged in the Roughness modulation pin.

params.name: blending_ramp
params.label: Blending ramp
params.description: Control additional variation of of octaves combination.

params.name: blending_ramp_modulation_active
params.label: Blending ramp modulation
params.description: Activate the blending ramp modulation from an external texture.

params.name: blending_ramp_modulation
params.label: Blending ramp modulation intensity
params.description: Scale the intensity of the blending ramp according the value of the mask plugged in the Blending ramp modulation pin.

params.name: uv_amplitude
params.label: UV distortion
params.description: Amount of UV based distortion applied to the whole texture.

params.name: uv_modulation_active
params.label: UV modulation
params.description: Activate the UV modulation from an external texture.

params.name: uv_modulation
params.label: UV modulation intensity
params.description: Scale the intensity of the uv modulation according the value of the mask plugged in the UV modulation pin.

params.name: rotation_range
params.label: Rotation range
params.description: Range of random rotation angles for the splats.

params.name: snap_angle
params.label: Snap to angle
params.description: Snaps the random rotation to the nearest multiple of this angle. A value of 0 disables snapping.

params.name: align_to_uv
params.label: Align to UVs
params.description:
Method of aligning the splats to the UV flow.

Ignore: Individual splats won’t be deformed or rotated by the connected UV map.
Per splat: Individual splats will be rotated by the connected UV map.
Per pixel: Individual splats will be rotated and deformed by the connected UV map.

params.name: flip_randomization
params.label: Flip randomization
params.description: Randomly flip (or not flip) the splats horizontally or vertically.

params.name: scale_range
params.label: Scale range
params.description: Range of sizes for the splats relative to the grid cell size.

params.name: scale_modulation_active
params.label: Scale modulation
params.description: Activate the scale modulation from an external texture.

params.name: scale_modulation
params.label: Scale modulation intensity
params.description: Scale the elements according the value of the mask plugged in the Scale modulation pin.

params.name: intensity_range
params.label: Intensity range
params.description:
Range of intensities for the splats.

Lower values result in darker splats, higher values result in brighter splats.

params.name: intensity_modulation_active
params.label: Intensity modulation
params.description: Activate the intensity modulation from an external texture.

params.name: intensity_modulation
params.label: Intensity modulation intensity
params.description: Scale the intensity of the elements according the value of the modulation plugged in the Intensity modulation pin.

params.name: horizontal_scale_range
params.label: Horizontal scale range
params.description: Range of horizontal scaling for the splats.

params.name: vertical_scale_range
params.label: Vertical scale range
params.description: Range of vertical scaling for the splats.

params.name: position_randomization
params.label: Position randomization
params.description:
Randomization amount for the splat position.

0% will align the splats to a grid, higher values will deviate from the grid to create a more organic look.

params.name: horizontal_randomization_scale
params.label: Horizontal randomization scale
params.description:
Multiplier for the horizontal position randomization. 

A value of 0% will remove all horizontal translation created by the Position randomization parameter.

params.name: vertical_randomization_scale
params.label: Vertical randomization scale
params.description:
Multiplier for the vertical position randomization.

A value of 0% will remove all vertical translation created by the Position randomization parameter.

params.name: quincunx
params.label: Quincunx
params.description:
Offsets every other column or row of splats by half a cell size.

This is like the positioning of rows of bricks.

params.name: visibility_randomization
params.label: Overall visibility chance
params.description:
Probability of being visible per splat.

params.name: smoothness

params.description: Smoothness of the smooth min and smooth max blending mode.

params.name: intensity
params.label: Cross mix
params.description: A value of 0% will give 100% background, a value of 50% will give a perfect blend of the background and foreground, a value of 100% will give 100% of foreground.

params.name: foreground_color
params.label: Foreground color
params.description: Constant foreground color used when nothing is plugged into the Foreground pin.

params.name: mask_source
params.label: Mask source
params.description: Defines the base on which the mask is built.

params.name: alpha_match_blend_mode
params.label: Alpha match blend mode
params.description: Make the alpha channel match the blend mode of the node. If disabled the alpha channel will be blended using regular alpha blending.

params.name: oklab_blend
params.label: OKLab blend
params.description: Composite the mask and Cross mix in OKLab instead of linear RGB. The blend mode operation itself is unchanged.

params.name: mask_contrast
params.label: Mask contrast
params.description: Mask contrast.

params.name: auto_level
params.label: Auto level
params.description: When true, normalize the output so its minimum and maximum values fill the [0, 1] range. For color, the same min/max scaling is applied to all channels so hue is preserved.

params.name: clamp_output
params.label: Clamp output
params.description: Only meaningful when Auto level is on. When off, blend operations that can exceed [0, 1] (Add, Subtract, ...) are stored remapped into [0, 1] so no information is lost — the auto-level pass then stretches the actual range back to [0, 1] with full precision. When on, out-of-range values are clamped first (lossy for high-magnitude blends).

params.description: Time of the blend for the first frame.

params.name: playback_mode
params.label: Playback mode
params.description:
The playback mode to perform when blending the flowmap.

Timeline playback mode ensures that the mix is blended perfectly in sync with the timeline. This is useful to blend between flowmaps generated by optical flow in slow motion.

Parameter playback mode exposes the 'Flow mix' parameter which defines a 0% to 100% range mix.

params.name: mix
params.label: Flow mix
params.description: A value of 0% will give 100% of the 'from' frame, a value of 50% will give a perfect blend of the background and foreground, a value of 100% will give 100% of the 'to' frame.

params.name: intensity
params.label: Flow intensity
params.description: How intense the flowmap is when warping from the 'from' frame to the 'to' frame. This should match the 'Encoded intensity' parameter of the 'Optical Flow' node if it is being used to produce the flowmap.

params.name: dual_flow
params.label: Dual Flow
params.description:
Enables dual flow where a second flowmap that is the inverse of the main flowmap is used.

This can improve the accuracy of flows, especially at larger flow distances.

params.label: Scale
params.description: Scale of the projection. This is like zooming in or out on the texture.

params.name: aperture_angle
params.label: Aperture angle
params.description: Angle defining the aperture coverage on the angular axis.

params.name: aperture_radial
params.label: Aperture radial scaling
params.description:
Width defining the aperture coverage on the radial axis.

Scale the distance between the inside and outside. The scaling will be done from the circle defined in the Aperture radial centering parameter.

params.name: aperture_radial_center
params.label: Aperture radial centering
params.description:
Pivot for the aperture radial scaling.

0% will scale from the center, 100% will scale from the outer ring.

params.name: distance_type
params.label: Distance
params.description: Method of remapping the distance to the center.

params.name: squircle_factor
params.label: Squircle factor
params.description: Rounding factor of the squircle.

params.name: perspective
params.label: Perspective
params.description: Deform the polar coordinates to look like a tunnel.

params.name: pinch
params.label: Pinch
params.description: Center pinching. Higher values will pull the pixels more towards the center.

params.name: overlap
params.label: Overlap range
params.description: Overlap beginning and end to soften the seam visible when using a non-tiling input.

params.name: overlap_type
params.label: Overlap scale
params.description:
Blend between scale overlap and clamp overlap mode.

A setting of 100% effectively counteracts the pixel extension that occurs at seams due to the overlap range, which often results in improved blending.

params.name: spiral
params.label: Spiral
params.description: Angle offset based on distance from center. Higher values will give a more twisted, swirly look.

params.name: out_of_range_clamp
params.label: Out of range clamping
params.description: Clamp all repeating patterns outside of the 0 to 1 range.

params.name: angular_tiling
params.label: Angular tiling
params.description: Tile the texture multiple times along the angular axis.

params.name: radial_tiling
params.label: Radial tiling
params.description: Tile the texture multiple times along the radial axis.

params.label: Capture first frame
params.description: The first timeline frame to start capturing.

params.label: Capture number of frames
params.description: Total number of frames that will be captured.

params.name: capture_region.stride_frames
params.label: Capture stride
params.description: Number of frames between each captured image.

params.name: loop_start_offset
params.label: Loop start offset
params.description: The frame offset to apply for the first frame in the looped sequence.

params.name: first_frame
params.label: First frame
params.description: The first timeline frame to start playback.

params.name: num_frames
params.label: Number of frames
params.description: Total number of frames that will be played back.

params.name: stride_frames
params.label: Stride
params.description: Number of frames between each played back image.

params.name: loop
params.label: Loop
params.description: Loop playback output

params.name: use_optical_flow
params.label: Loop with optical flow
params.description:
Use optical flow for loop blending to try and hide the crossfade loop point.

Optical flow will distort the image in an attempt to smoothly align the two images in the sequence to lay on top of one another.

params.name: blur_radius
params.label: Blur radius
params.description: Maximal radius of the blur applied after flow has been analysed.

params.name: blur_sigma
params.label: Blur sigma
params.description: The sigma value of the blur applied after flow has been analysed.

params.name: flow_distance
params.label: Flow distance
params.description:
How far a pixel can flow from one frame to another.

A larger value can let a pixel travel further with smoother motion at the cost of potentially producing unwanted motion and reducing accuracy.

You should try and keep the distance as low as possible and only increase it when you must flow larger distances.

params.name: obscurance_threshold
params.label: Obscurance threshold
params.description:
The threshold used to determine if a pixel has become obscured or not, a lower threshold means more pixels will be marked as obscured.

Obscured pixels will not move and will remain stationary with the aim of reducing unwanted motion at the cost of potential smoothness.

params.name: neighbour_radius
params.label: Neighbour radius
params.description:
The window of pixels to use when determining how a pixel moves within a frame.

Larger windows means more neighbouring pixels are needed to match to find the direction of flow.

params.name: travel_cost
params.label: Travel cost
params.description:
The cost for a pixel to flow in any given direction.

Pixels want to flow to the location of least cost.

You can use this to reduce unwanted motion at the cost of potential smoothness.

params.name: upflow_warp_radius
params.label: Upflow radius
params.description:
The radius to blur the flow when analysing at progressively higher resolutions.

Lower values can create a sharper flow, whereas higher values will make flow more locally uniform.

params.name: user_encoded_intensity
params.label: Intensity
params.description: The intensity of the flow vector.

params.name: obscurance_flow
params.label: Obscurance flow
params.description:
How much motion a pixel is allowed to keep when obscured.

Lower values will cause pixels to move less.

You can use this to reduce unwanted motion at the cost of potential smoothness.

params.name: dual_flow
params.label: Dual Flow
params.description:
Enables dual flow where a second flowmap that is the inverse of the main flowmap is used.

This can improve the accuracy of flows, especially at larger flow distances.

params.name: delight
params.label: Delight
params.description: Removes large-scale lighting (shadows, gradients) from the albedo by dividing out the low-frequency luminance. 0% keeps the photo as-is.

params.name: lighting_scale
params.label: Lighting scale
params.description: Size of the lighting variation removed for the albedo. Lower removes finer shading; higher removes only broad gradients.

params.name: remove_highlights
params.label: Remove highlights
params.description: Detects specular highlights (bright outliers against the local base level) and fills them with the surrounding de-lit color; they are also flattened in the height and roughness. 0% disables it.

params.name: height_contrast
params.label: Height contrast
params.description: Contrast of the extracted height (relief). Higher exaggerates the depth between light and dark structure.

params.name: invert_height
params.label: Invert height
params.description: Swap which tones are high and low (use when darker areas are raised rather than recessed).

params.name: height_denoise
params.label: Height denoise
params.description: Edge-preserving (bilateral) smoothing of the height to remove speckle while keeping structural edges sharp. 0% disables it.

params.name: roughness_level
params.label: Roughness level
params.description: Base roughness of the surface.

params.name: roughness_variation
params.label: Roughness variation
params.description: How much local detail/texture modulates the roughness around the base level.

params.name: roughness_scale
params.label: Roughness detail size
params.description: Size of the local detail measured for the roughness variation. Lower reacts only to fine grain; higher also to broader texture.

params.name: invert_roughness
params.label: Invert roughness
params.description: Flip the roughness response (detailed areas become smoother instead of rougher).

params.name: blur_radius
params.label: Blur radius
params.description: Maximal radius of the blur applied after flow has been analysed.

params.name: blur_sigma
params.label: Blur sigma
params.description: The sigma value of the blur applied after flow has been analysed.

params.name: flow_distance
params.label: Flow distance
params.description:
How far a pixel can flow from one frame to another.

A larger value can let a pixel travel further with smoother motion at the cost of potentially producing unwanted motion and reducing accuracy.

You should try and keep the distance as low as possible and only increase it when you must flow larger distances.

params.name: obscurance_threshold
params.label: Obscurance threshold
params.description:
The threshold used to determine if a pixel has become obscured or not, a lower threshold means more pixels will be marked as obscured.

Obscured pixels will not move and will remain stationary with the aim of reducing unwanted motion at the cost of potential smoothness.

params.name: neighbour_radius
params.label: Neighbour radius
params.description:
The window of pixels to use when determining how a pixel moves within a frame.

Larger windows means more neighbouring pixels are needed to match to find the direction of flow.

params.name: travel_cost
params.label: Travel cost
params.description:
The cost for a pixel to flow in any given direction.

Pixels want to flow to the location of least cost.

You can use this to reduce unwanted motion at the cost of potential smoothness.

params.name: upflow_warp_radius
params.label: Upflow radius
params.description:
The radius to blur the flow when analysing at progessively higher resolutions.

Lower values can create a sharper flow, whereas higher values will make flow more locally uniform.

params.name: encoded_intensity
params.label: Intensity
params.description: The intensity of the flow vector.

params.name: obscurance_flow
params.label: Obscurance flow
params.description:
How much motion a pixel is allowed to keep when obscured.

Lower values will cause pixels to move less.

You can use this to reduce unwanted motion at the cost of potential smoothness.

params.name: flow_passes
params.label: Flow passes
params.description: Number of refinement passes for the flow field. More passes produce smoother, more coherent brush-stroke directions.

params.name: flow_radius
params.label: Flow radius
params.description: How far each flow pass looks for neighbours. Larger values create a more globally smooth flow at the cost of computation.

params.name: line_width
params.label: Line width
params.description: Thickness of detected edges. Larger values produce wider, bolder lines.

params.name: line_contrast
params.label: Line contrast
params.description: Ratio between the two edge Gaussians. Higher values boost contrast between lines and their surroundings.

params.name: stroke_length
params.label: Stroke length
params.description: How far along the flow lines are integrated. Larger values produce longer, more continuous strokes with fewer gaps.

params.name: edge_sharpness
params.label: Edge sharpness
params.description: Sharpness of the edge threshold. Low values give soft, sketchy lines; high values give crisp, graphic contours.

params.name: hard_edges
params.label: Hard edges
params.description: Switch to a harder edge thresholding mode. Produces bolder, more graphic lines. Works best with high Edge sharpness.

params.name: edge_threshold
params.label: Edge threshold
params.description: Sensitivity of edge detection. Raise to suppress thin or noisy edges; lower to pick up fine detail. Only active with Hard edges enabled.

params.name: detail_boost
params.label: Detail boost
params.description: Amplifies fine-detail contrast before thresholding. Only active with Hard edges enabled.

params.name: use_edges
params.label: Apply edges to output
params.description: Multiply the detected edge mask into the stylized output, producing visible contour lines. The Edge Mask output is always available regardless of this setting.

params.name: invert_lines
params.label: Invert Edge mask
params.description: Invert the Edge Mask output (white lines on black instead of black lines on white). Does not affect the main stylized output.

params.name: smoothing
params.label: Smoothing
params.description: Controls the reach of the edge-preserving blur. Larger values flatten broader regions. Color tolerance scales automatically with the radius.

params.name: color_levels
params.label: Color levels
params.description: Number of soft luminance quantization levels. Lower values produce a more stylized, poster-like result.

params.name: level_blending
params.label: Level blending
params.description: Softness of transitions between color levels. At 0 each level snaps hard to its midpoint; at 1 transitions blend smoothly across the full level width.

params.name: level_threshold
params.label: Threshold bias
params.description: Offsets where within each color level the transition to the next occurs. Negative values bias transitions toward brighter tones; positive values toward darker.

params.name: use_oklab
params.label: Perceptual quantization
params.description: Quantizes tonal levels in OKLab perceptual lightness space instead of linear luminance, producing more visually uniform bands across all tones.

params.name: stylize_amount
params.label: Stylize amount
params.description: Blends from the original input (0%) to the fully stylized result (100%).

params.name: use_sharpening
params.label: Sharpening
params.description: Sharpens the boundaries between colour regions after smoothing, giving the result a crisper, more graphic quality.

params.name: sharpening_strength
params.label: Strength
params.description: How strongly region boundaries are sharpened. Higher values produce harder, more graphic colour transitions.

params.name: sharpening_scale
params.label: Scale
params.description: Pixel distance used to measure colour transitions. Small values sharpen fine detail; large values target broader region boundaries.

params.name: sharpening_threshold
params.label: Edge sensitivity
params.description: Minimum edge strength before sharpening is applied. Raise to protect flat or noisy areas from being affected.

params.name: flow_uv_intensity
params.label: Warp amount
params.description: How strongly the flow direction warps the UV map. At 0 the output is a plain identity UV; at 100% each texel is offset by one full texture width along its flow direction.

params.name: flow_uv_weighting
params.label: Weighting
params.description: At 100% the UV map intensity is modulated according to the Sobel gradient, at 0% the intensity is the same on the whole texture.
